item.subject: Advanced Mathematics
item.stem: The graph of the function g passes through the point (1,2). The slope of the tangent to the graph at any point (x, y) is given by g'(x) = 6x − 12. What is g(x)? Show all your work.

descriptors: g(x) = 3x^2 - 12x + 11. Method: First the function g is determined to be of the form g(x) = 3x^2 - 12 x + c. Then c is found to be 11 by solving the equation g(1) = 2, i.e. 3 - 12 + c = 2.

Answer of the form g(x) = 3 x^2 - 12 x + c, where c is a numerical value other than 11. Method correct; the value of c given incorrectly due to error in solving the equation g(1) = 2. If c = 13, check to determine if 13 results from an error in solving g(1) = 2[code 21] or from solving correctly the "reversed" equation, g(2) = 1 [code 22].
Method: Solves the "reversed" equation g(2) = 1 and determines the value of c to be 13. If an error is made in solving the reversed equation; c determined to be a number other than 13, use code 11.
Answers of the form g(x) = 3x^2 -12x + c, where the value of c is NOT determined by solving either g(1) = 2 or g(2) = 1.
Other nearly complete solutions with a minor error.
Answer of the form g(x) = 3x^2 - 12 x + c, where a numerical value of c is NOT found.
Method: Incorrectly solves "reversed" equation g(2) = 1, finds c to be a number other than 13.
Answers of the form g(x) = 6x^2 - ... or other integration error.
Crossed-out, illegible, or impossible to interpret.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 3-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent scaling of the TIMSS Advanced 1995 and 2008 advanced mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 3-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent scaling of the TIMSS Advanced 1995 and 2008 advanced mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

step1.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 3-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent scaling of the TIMSS Advanced 1995 and 2008 advanced mathematics data". What is the item's step 1 parameter d1? In the GPCM, b - d1 is the ability at which earning the first point becomes more likely than earning no point, so a higher d1 means that this point is earned at a lower ability; the steps sum to 0. Choose the value closest to it.

step2.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 3-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent scaling of the TIMSS Advanced 1995 and 2008 advanced mathematics data". What is the item's step 2 parameter d2? In the GPCM, b - d2 is the ability at which earning the second point becomes more likely than earning only the first, so a higher d2 means that this point is earned at a lower ability; the steps sum to 0. Choose the value closest to it.
